description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Nesarasa as a member of the Point Pedro U/C and U. Vikna as a member of the Meritimepattu P/S
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Point Pedro Urban Council and Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignations, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of new members by political parties and returning officers, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
